//: Single source of truth for the compiler options shared by every web/Node project in the monorepo (packages via ./tsconfig.json, the Next.js apps directly). Keep ONLY options that should be identical everywhere — notably the strictness flags (`strict`, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`) so they can't drift per-project. Project-specific knobs (lib, jsx, declaration, paths, outDir, …) stay in the individual tsconfigs. The mobile app extends `expo/tsconfig.base` instead (separate React Native toolchain) and re-declares these flags locally — see apps/mobile/tsconfig.json.
